scenarios.name: Handle a missing customization import file

scenario_steps.name: the ribbon customization dialog is open with no pending changes
the customization import file picker is open
the user enters a path to a nonexistent XML file and clicks "Open"
a warning says the file was not found and asks the user to check its name
the import file picker remains open with the filename selected
the user cancels the file picker
the customization dialog remains open without a pending-change marker
